# Photos Needed for Pack 351 Website

Drop real photos into this folder (`site/public/photos/`) with the exact filenames below.
The site automatically shows the photo once the file exists — no code changes needed.

---

## Activity Photos (Homepage grid + Events + About)

| Filename | Used on | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `photo-camping.jpg` | Home (large hero grid tile) | Family camping trip — ideally scouts at camp, tents, or outdoors. **Largest photo on the site — make it a good one.** |
| `photo-pinewood-derby.jpg` | Home grid, Events page | Cars on the Pinewood Derby track |
| `photo-regatta.jpg` | Home grid, Events page | Raingutter Regatta boats racing |
| `photo-hiking.jpg` | Home grid, About page | Scouts on a hiking trail |
| `photo-candy-cane.jpg` | Home grid, Events page, About page | Candy cane fundraiser in the Hideaway neighborhood |
| `photo-blue-gold.jpg` | Home grid | Blue & Gold Banquet |
| `photo-group.jpg` | About page (large banner) | Full pack group shot — all scouts and leaders together |

---

## Photo tips
- **Format**: JPG or PNG works. JPG is preferred for photos.
- **Size**: Aim for 1200px on the longest side. Larger is fine; smaller may look blurry.
- **Cropping**: Activity photos display as rectangles (roughly 16:9 or wider). Leader headshots display as circles (square crop works best).
- **BSA Brand Center**: For stock/filler photos while you gather real ones, visit https://www.scouting.org/programs/cub-scouts/ or search for Cub Scout imagery in the BSA Media Resources.

## After adding photos
Commit the new photo and push to `main` — the site is on GitHub Pages and the
deploy workflow rebuilds and republishes automatically. (To preview locally first:
`npm run build` then `npm run preview` from the `site/` folder.)
